description: This file defines a React component 'ToastProvider' along with context and hooks to manage toast notifications within a React application. It includes types for toast messages, API methods for triggering toasts, and the rendering logic for toast UI elements.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string based on current timestamp and a random component.

methods.name: ToastProvider
methods.description: React component that provides toast notification context and UI rendering, manages toast state, and API.

methods.name: useToast
methods.description: Custom hook that provides access to toast notification API, intended to be used within ToastProvider.
